volume.title: Undying
volume.author: Cuttlefish That Loves Diving
volume.title_meaning: Undying, a bestowment or a curse, is the theme of Volume 4. It is manifested on many people in the story: Klein, Azik, Leonard, Anderson, etc. This theme reaches the peak when Klein saw the cocoons, the modern people inside, and the three broken ones. The horror, madness and darkness of this world is revealed once again. (paraphrased from the author's words at the end of Volume 4)
volume.synopsis: After Klein returned to Backlund, he assumed the identity of Dwayne Dantès, and started seeking an opportunity to steal Antigonus Family's Notebook which was in Saint Samuel Cathedral. Alger traded characteristics of Ocean Songster with the location of a Primitive Island. He and Gehrman then explored the island, and discovered the betrayal behind Ancient Sun God's Death. Klein received the Card of Blasphemy, Tyrant. Then they heard a sigh, and the island disappeared in front of their eyes. Later Klein sneaked into the Chanis Gate of Saint Samuel Cathedral and was sent to the Foggy Town by Sealed Artifact 0-17. He killed Mr. A, met (a part of) Zaratul and was tricked to release him, and finally escaped from this place under the watch of Evernight Goddess. Leonard connected Gehrman Sparrow to Sherlock Moriarty and to Klein Moretti. He went back to dig Klein's grave, and realized that Klein was not dead. Dwayne then convinced him that Klein was resurrected and was a believer of The Fool. The military asked Dwayne to sell weapons to the Southern Continent. Klein accepts the deal and sent Danitz to investigate. Danitz then met Anderson there. After he learned that Amon has come to Backlund, Klein took the chance to leave for the Southern Continent. A Red Glove team that included Leonard and Daly was also sent there to hunt for members of the Numinous Episcopate. Azik and Klein boarded The Black Tulip because Admiral Hell Ludwell seemed to possess an item related to Death. Azik asked Ludwell to give up his life and become Klein's marionette. Azik then felt something calling him inside the Berserk Sea, which turned out to be the Artificial Death, the Death's plan for resurrection. Evernight Goddess took the Uniqueness and separated Azik's soul from a bird shape accessory. Azik got rid of the influence from Death, but had to sleep for a long time to recover. Ince Zangwill also came to the Southern Continent, to exorcise the Red Angel Evil Spirit. Under the influence/help of Adam, Klein, Leonard, and Daly finally get their revenge and killed Ince. Adam took Sealed Artifact 0-08, and Klein completed the ritual to promote to sequence 4.

timeline_of_major_events.event: Klein returned to Backlund. He visited Isengard Stanton, Ian Wright, and Sharron. Klein and Sharron explored the underground structure in Williams Street. Gehrman is officially wanted, with a bounty of 50,000 pounds.
Klein plans to have a butler. Klein saw Bernadette Gustav at the restaurant, Intis Srenzo Restaurant. Fors promoted to Astrologer.

Klein interviewed the butler, and finally chose Walter. Klein rents Unit 160 Böklund Street. Tarot Club 44th meeting. Emlyn hunted Windsor the Primordial Moon's believer. Emlyn prayed to The Fool to helps him destroy the Moon Puppet. Blood Moon suddenly appeared. Alger dreamed of the Queen of Calamity Cohinem.

Klein investigates the origins of the Moon puppet. Soest promoted to the Spirit Warlock. Leonard promoted to Soul Assurer. Xio was invited to Mr. X's Beyonder Gathering. Leonard entered Mrs. Sammer's dream to investigate Sherlock Moriarty.

Sharron summoned Sherlock's messenger, then she recognized Reinette Tinekerr. Klein went to the Evernight Church. He met Leonard. Pallez Zoroast sensed the gray fog. Klein warned Leonard about Pallez. Maury Macht and Bishop Elektra visited Klein's house.

Klein destroys a small lair of members of Eternal Life Society that were threatening Richardson. Fors confirmed Mr. X is Lewis Wien and report to Klein. Xio went to a meeting of beyonders where she met Mr. X. Klein pays a little of the debt he owes to Reinette Tinekerr. Derrick promoted to the Notary.

Tarot Club 45th meeting. Derrick is allowed to choose between two Sealed Artifacts, Cardi's Ring or Thunder God's Roar, with Derrick ultimately choosing the latter. Klein and Will Auceptin have an encounter and conversation in Klein's dream. Name revealed of the grandfather and parasite that Leonard has inside: Pallez Zoroast.
Klein accepted the commission to assassinate Lewis Wien. Trissy killed William Sykes. Walter met Trissy in the sewer. Klein met Trissy and agreed to cooperate with her.
Klein participated in a tea session at Member of Parliament Macht's residence. Klein went to pray at the Saint Samuel Cathedral. Arrodes helps Klein when he is absent.

Klein killed and grazed Mr. X of the Aurora Order. Arrodes embarrasses acquaintances of Klein Moretti as Dwayne Dantès. Klein gets The Flower of Blood from Mr. X. Klein finally releases the last soul that had Creeping Hunger inside: Andy Haydn.
Alger promoted to the Ocean Songster.

Fors met Dorian at the Hat Trick Inn, gave him the decapitated head of Lewis Wien and received a Star Crystal crystal ball for an Astrologer. Roy Wellesley of the Mandated Punishers was named (previously tasked on December 16, 1349 to investigate the assassination of Duke Negan).

Tarot Club 46th meeting. Emlyn hunted two Primordial Moon's believers, These being Galis Kevin and Argos. As a reward for eliminating three believers from the primordial moon, Emlyn obtains Lilith's Ring from Cosmi Odora.

Klein meets up with some old friends (Aaron Ceres, Mike Joseph and Luke Sammer) And hear about Syndras again. Klein discovered his second personality in his body. He asked Emlyn to borrow the Mental Terror Candle from Utravsky. Then he killed his second personality.

Alger Wilson used his singing that attracts corruption to obtain the fruit from the Illusionary Bell Tree. Klein And Alger have various encounters with beyonder creatures. Battle of Klein and Alger against powerful corpses and a gargoyle. Klein and Alger explored the Primitive Island at night. Klein gained the Card of Blasphemy, The Tyrant. The Primitive Island disappeared before their eyes. Daly Simone secretly looked at the house of Dwayne Dantès At night as she passed by. Klein held a ball and met the unborn Will Ceres Who told him that the sigh from the mysterious island he heard was from an angel And warned him about Hazel Macht. Klein and Hazel have a dance and Klein was able to get some information out of her.
Xio met Sherman while seeking out clues to the Interrogator potion formula in East Borough. Xio was tasked by MI9 in the evening to watch over Viscount Stratford.

Tarot Club 47th meeting. Klein tries to destroy Hazel's progress in the sewers but a possible demigod in the same sewers thwarts Klein's plans and in the end 'he' ends up detonating the explosives 'Himself'.
Dwayne Dantès tried to explode the sewers. Dwayne meet with snake of fate will, in his dream.
Gerhman Sparrow have a meeting with Bernadette, and ask her to corrupt his marionette senor, with the chanis gated corruption.
Audrey got the Hand of Horror from the artisan using Mentor of Disorder Beyonder characteristic.

Klein sneaked into the Chanis Gate. Klein had a mini encounter with Leonard as they walked in opposite directions but no anomaly happened between the two. Klein was sent to the Foggy Town by Sealed Artifact 0-17. This week the Tarot meeting was canceled. Klein meets Panatiya in Foggy Town, who was one of the biggest causes of the Great Smog of Backlund, and she was also sent by the Angel of Concealment. The Danger comes when the fog hides the moon. Klein meets Mr. A in Foggy Town, as a result, they have a small battle that doesn't escalate to much, then, Mr. A escapes. As Klein escaped from Panatiya, he entered the city's cathedral, encountering a gloomy scene, Watching the scene, Klein confirmed that Foggy Town is Hornacis Mountain Range. Klein inside the cathedral meets Zaratul, who decides to help him and tell him the way out of that place. In addition, 'He' also gives him various useful information. Klein collaborates with Panatiya and Mr. A to open the door and escape. Zaratul gives Klein a symbol to open the door and tells him to take 'His' ashes with him, then disappears shortly after, leaving said ashes in 'His' place. The trio opens the door using the symbol Zaratul gave but they find themselves seeing a corrupted Sequence 1 Beyonder in 'His' Mythical Creature form and suffer. Through his fake Gehrman Sparrow Marionette, Klein discovers the Card of Blasphemy of the Fool Pathway but is unable to obtain it due to the corrupted Beyonder. Klein finally leaves the Hornacis Mountain Range by drawing Evernight's Dark Sacred Emblem on the door and returns to his normal life. Audrey's 18th birthday party occurs.
Audrey and Klein have a session. Leonard dug Klein's grave and entered Dwayne Dantès's dream to confirm.

Fors and Xio hired to be bodyguards for Dwayne Dantès. Fors and Xio discover that Walter is doing something unknown with dark magic. Klein plans to start a foundation with the church's help to help the poor; the goddess would be proud.

Audrey promoted to the Hypnotist. Frank Lee sent his second prototype mushrooms to Klein. Fors and Xio discover that Richardson is secretly a follower of death. Fors Wall dreams of a strange castle And tarot cards.
At the charity party, Klein, Audrey and Susie first met.
Tarot Club 48th meeting.

Arrodes shoots a ray at the rat with a parasite inside that was talking to Hazel Macht. Klein assigned Danitz, took the Sun Brooch to West Balam to investigate the situation. Leonard discreetly visits Klein (as dantes) and they begin to discuss Baron cuaron Homicide. Sharron and Maric asked Klein to help them steal the mummy, They discover that the mummy is a trap set by the Loen Kingdom for the Rose School of Thought. Klein learned Amon's avatar came to Backlund and searching for the Fool's believers. He sent a letter to Leonard.

The encounter between MI9 and the Rose School of Thought occurs (Celt and Georgina Augustus vs Mahmosi and Zatwen). Klein, Sharron and Maric successfully stole the mummy under the eyes of Celt and the other demigods. Klein receives his payment and Sharron may possibly become a demigod. Zatwen has an encounter with Amon's avatar, and the latter manages to steal the sealed artifact that Zatwel possessed of The Error Pathway.

Red Gloves prepare to travel to the Southern Continent to investigate the Numinous Episcopate. Before he went to the Southern Continent, Klein noticed Qonas Kilgor in the East Balam Military Veterans Mess. In a conversation, Klein realizes that Arrodes can't say or show anything about Mother Tree of Desire. Arrodes reveals that the mastermind behind Cuarón's suicide was Hvin Rambis, a royal family consultant and important member of the psychological alchemists.
Tarot Club 49th meeting. Danitz arrived at West Balam and met Anderson Hood. Klein boarded an airship. Daly promoted to the Gatekeeper.

Colin Iliad prayed to The Fool. After 2,583 years, the City of Silver had finally received a normal response. Three Elders of the City of Silver (Colin Iliad, Lovia Tiffany, Waite Chirmont) explored the former chief's mausoleum. Klein makes a dream revelation, which results in something dangerous and harmful to himself, but he does not give it importance since it is related to death and azik. The trio of elders after exploring and fighting in the mausoleum, meet the former chief. Alger visited Cielf June and found his abnormality. Danitz Dubois and Anderson hood obtain the Language Comprehension Charm of a bishop.

A demigod (who can transform into a spear of white flames at will) arrives at the ship where Klein is, looking for someone, but leaves shortly after. Klein found Ince Zangwill along the way in The ship, at Berserk Sea, On waypoint island. Klein discovers shortly after that the demigod is possibly looking for Ince Zangwill. In between messages with Reinette Tinekerr, Leonard sends a warning to Klein about the 0-08 artifact and ince, saying that they shouldn't act yet and that he shouldn't mention it. Klein finally reaches the Southern Continent (kolain city), loses two people who were following him, and finds his first marionette, oaf. Captain Soest red-gloved team (with Leonard Mitchell and Daly simone) arrives in the Lower Lip district to hunt down Ulika, a key member of Numinous Episcopate. Ulika is captured by Daly and Enzo escapes. Enzo The winner turned into Klein's marionette after Fighting with him (in the process, oaf is exploited). Klein obtains the Green Essence object that Enzo was carrying. Klein, using the Enzo puppet, wants to look at himself to see what is special about him, with the necessary preparations, Klein did so, watching A door of light tainted with bluish-black. Countless spherical lights. Transparent and translucent maggots clumped together, a scene that Beyonders of the Fate pathway see on him. Alger and cattleya meet in person for the first time un bayam While they discuss Cielf June the artisan and the believers of the primordial moon. Secretly, a member of the future was listening to the conversation with cattleya; it was Heath Doyle.

Azik finally arrives with Klein Moretti prepared. Klein tells Azik about the dreams where the two of them are in an inverted mausoleum with black fog. Azik Eggers and Klein boarded on the Black Tulip And with Azik's help, he controls and obtains Ludwell as a new marionette. Klein gets back the Murloc Cufflink that he had previously lost. Azik takes Klein to the site of the inverted mausoleum, somewhere in the Berserk Sea. Klein himself believes that Artificial Death is found there. Azik tells Klein about his beautiful but melancholic past of so many reincarnations he lived through. The reason Azik always revived after dying is because his soul was separated. Angel of Concealment(although it is revealed that Evernight Goddess controls her at will) appears before the situation escalates, giving Azik three options. Azik, choosing one option, loses half of his soul, but Azik is calm, leaving Klein in Kolain city, telling Klein that he should sleep for some time, disappearing shortly after. Evernight Goddess took the uniqueness of the Death Pathway. Leonard Mitchell discovers that Azik Eggers is a Death Consul and that supposedly represents Death in the Secret Organization that worships the Fool. Klein discovers the origins of Calderón City because arrodes told him. Alger Wilson and Cattleya They 'rescued' Cielf June from some members of the Rose School of Thought, set him free, but Cattleya collected some of his blood. Klein plans his trip with drip to Calderón City using the Tyrant's card of Blasphemy.

Klein went to Calderón City. Using his powers, Klein slaughters living creatures in Calderon City while coming face-to-face with a Spirit World Plunderer. Klein successfully manages to hunt down the spirit world plunderer. Unfortunately for Klein, Ouroboros appears shortly thereafter, but Klein manages to escape in time. Red Gloves found Ince Zangwil's trace in East Balam Due to Palenque Taciblius. Klein warns his fellow pirates Friends about the various evil secret organizations.(Lazy to add Specific Names). Tarot Club 50th meeting. Klein decides to pray for Artificial Death for specific information about Ince Zangwill, since death is no longer a threat. With the new information, Klein suspects that Ince zangwill is being possessed by the evil spirit Medici. Leonard gets new information about evil spirits from Daly for his boyfriend Klein (joke). Colin and Derrick set off to explore Nois City. Alger and his crew plan to go to Bansy Harbor. Klein learns of Will Auceptin birth and pays him a short visit for a chat.
Colin and Derrick are able to successfully hunt a Shapeshifter and obtain the Bizzaro Bane Beyonder characteristic.

Ince Zangwill uses the effects of the quill on the squadron of Soest. Using a type of 'bait', Collin's squad manages to lure and kill some shapeshifters, obtaining their Beyonder characteristics. Leonard and Daly begin to suspect that artifact 0-08 knows about them. Ince Zangwill appeared at West Balam. Main article: Death of Ince Zangwill. Klein advanced to Bizarro Sorcerer and obtained the Card of Blasphemy, The Red Priest.
